newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Canadian company RedSea Oil begins drilling for oil in Libya.
- Morocco initially agrees with Spain's Slamenka Group to build a free trade and industrial zone.
- Jordanian team leaves to Iraq to discuss renewing oil contract with Baghdad.
- Arab banks will face difficulties unless they merge and raise their capital says senior banker.
- Abu Dhabi emirate's non-oil imports from Saudi Arabia last November were worth 190.8 million dirhams.
